test_cases.title: Admin login screen renders role choices and accessible controls
test_cases.description: Verify the login screen has a clear heading, role options, keyboard access, and no console errors.

steps.description: Open the admin base URL in a clean browser context
Login screen renders and all role controls have accessible names
Navigate controls using keyboard only
Focus is visible and activation works without a mouse

test_cases.title: Each supported demo role can sign in and persist a session
test_cases.description: Verify dispatcher, content editor, review moderator, finance operator, and super admin roles create a session and survive refresh.

steps.description: Select each role in a fresh context and sign in
The dashboard opens with the correct role identity and navigation
Refresh the browser
The session persists only for that browser context

test_cases.title: Logout clears admin session and protected UI
test_cases.description: Verify logout clears local storage and returns to the login screen; browser back does not restore the authenticated view.

steps.description: Sign in and select Logout
The login screen appears and the session key is removed
Use browser back and refresh
Protected dashboard content is not restored

test_cases.title: Admin primary routes and deep links work
test_cases.description: Verify dashboard, bookings, finance, catalog, reviews, inquiries, fares, and audit routes load directly and through sidebar navigation.

steps.description: Visit every route through the sidebar
Each route renders its heading and main content
Open each route directly and refresh
Deep link refresh does not fall into an unexpected blank or public page

test_cases.title: Role-specific navigation and protected actions are enforced
test_cases.description: Verify navigation and action visibility matches the declared AdminRole permission matrix and unauthorized actions are not executable by UI manipulation.

steps.description: Repeat the route and action inventory for every role
Each role sees only permitted navigation/actions according to the project RBAC contract
Attempt to activate a hidden action through keyboard or DOM manipulation
The UI refuses the action and does not report false success

test_cases.title: Bookings table handles loading, empty, error, and dense data states
test_cases.description: Verify bookings renders useful table/list states, filters, pagination, and safe formatting with long names and ticket IDs.

steps.description: Open bookings with mocked loading, empty, success, and API error responses
Each state has understandable feedback and retry behavior where relevant
Use status/filter/pagination controls with boundary values
Results update without stale rows or duplicate requests

test_cases.title: Finance and refund actions require confirmation and idempotency
test_cases.description: Verify finance screens do not perform a refund from a single accidental click and show a clear result for success, duplicate, and failure responses.

steps.description: Open a refund-capable record and click the refund action
A confirmation dialog identifies booking, amount, and reason before mutation
Cancel the dialog
No refund request was sent
Confirm once, repeat the same action, and simulate a duplicate response
UI shows one final state and does not double-refund

test_cases.title: Catalog and fare editing validate values before save
test_cases.description: Verify catalog/fare forms reject empty, negative, oversized, malformed, and unknown values and preserve unsaved edits correctly.

steps.description: Open catalog and fares forms
Enter invalid numeric, text, URL, and boundary values
Inline errors identify the field and save remains blocked
Enter valid values and save
The saved row reflects the new data exactly once

test_cases.title: Review moderation requires safe reason and correct status transitions
test_cases.description: Verify approve/reject/archive flows require appropriate confirmation/reason and render sanitized review content.

steps.description: Open a pending review containing HTML-like text
Text is rendered as text and no script executes
Reject without a reason, then with a valid reason
Empty reason is blocked and valid rejection updates the status once

test_cases.title: Inquiry management protects customer information
test_cases.description: Verify inquiries display only expected masked/authorized data, handle long text, and avoid leaking tokens in UI or errors.

steps.description: Open inquiries with normal and long messages
Layout remains readable and customer data is shown only to authorized roles
Trigger an API failure
The error omits database URLs, tokens, stack traces, and provider secrets

test_cases.title: Theme toggle and reduced motion are stable
test_cases.description: Verify light/dark theme preference persists safely and animations respect reduced motion.

steps.description: Toggle theme and refresh
The selected theme persists without flash or broken contrast
Enable prefers-reduced-motion and navigate between pages
Transitions are reduced without blocking content

test_cases.title: Admin responsive and keyboard accessibility
test_cases.description: Verify sidebar, tables, dialogs, forms, charts, and topbar work at mobile/tablet/desktop widths and with keyboard navigation.

steps.description: Test key screens at 320px, 768px, and desktop widths
No important control is clipped or unreachable
Open and close dialogs using keyboard Escape and Tab
Focus is trapped only inside open dialogs and returns to the trigger

test_cases.title: Admin refresh and unknown route behavior
test_cases.description: Verify an unknown admin route redirects safely and refresh does not expose a previous authenticated page in a logged-out context.

steps.description: Open an unknown route while logged out
The app redirects to login without exposing dashboard data
Open an unknown route while logged in
The app redirects to a safe admin default route

test_cases.title: Admin frontend contains no production secrets
test_cases.description: Verify built/admin runtime code contains no database credentials, service-role keys, payment secrets, or private provider tokens.

steps.description: Search loaded source maps/assets and DOM for secret-shaped values
No private credentials or backend-only configuration is shipped
API origin is configurable but secret-free

test_cases.title: Fleet catalog asset library picker, quick onboard presets, and live 16:9 photo preview
test_cases.description: Verify /vehicles enables super_admin to browse fleet presets, auto-fill model attributes, pick high-res assets from the library, and inspect live 16:9 previews.

steps.description: Navigate to /vehicles as super_admin
Fleet Asset Catalog & Quick Onboarding section displays Missing in Fleet and All Catalog tabs
Click '+ Onboard to Fleet' on a catalog preset card
Add Vehicle Model dialog opens pre-filled with preset make, model, passenger capacity, and photo URL
Select an image from Fleet Asset Library dropdown
Live photo preview updates in 16:9 frame displaying '✓ Image linked' badge

test_cases.title: Active vehicle models photo thumbnail preview and instant filter search
test_cases.description: Verify the active vehicle models table renders high-res photo thumbnails and filters rows immediately via search input.

steps.description: Open Vehicles & Vehicle Groups table on /vehicles
Vehicle models display photo thumbnails in the Model column with clean fallback
Type a vehicle name in the search input
Table immediately filters matching models and updates row counts without page reload

test_cases.title: Review Invitation & WhatsApp QR Studio dynamic link and scannable PNG download
test_cases.description: Verify dispatchers on /reviews can input customer and ticket details, generate invitation tokens, format WhatsApp links, and download printable PNG QR codes.

steps.description: Navigate to /reviews as dispatcher or review_moderator
Review Invitation & WhatsApp QR Studio is visible with Customer Name, Ticket ID, Chauffeur, and Tour inputs
Enter customer and ticket details and click 'Generate Token Link'
Generates review invitation URL and updates dynamic HTML5 QR code canvas
Click 'Share on WhatsApp' and 'Download Printable QR Code (PNG)'
WhatsApp URI contains pre-filled message and browser downloads review-qr-[ticketId].png

test_cases.title: Customer PII unmasking with mandatory immutable security audit logging
test_cases.description: Verify customer phone and email are masked by default in bookings and clicking 'Unmask PII' records an audit log.

steps.description: Navigate to /bookings and open booking details drawer as dispatcher
Customer phone and email are masked by default
Click 'Unmask PII'
Phone and email become visible in plain text
Backend records immutable UNMASK_CUSTOMER_PII audit log with actor ID and timestamp

test_cases.title: Pending booking 30-minute auto-expiry and cancellation status visibility
test_cases.description: Verify unpaid bookings abandoned past 30 minutes are shown as cancelled due to auto-expiry in the operations desk.

steps.description: Filter bookings table by status 'cancelled'
Bookings that were pending without payment for >30 minutes display cancelled status with auto-expiry notes
Expired bookings prevent manual confirmation without re-verifying current commercial tariff
